options.why: An explicit queue avoids one Python call frame per depth, so a long chain does not depend on recursion depth.
Sorting node IDs does not change the depth of the input tree or protect recursive calls.
Ignoring leaves would lose their level sums and change the answer.
Python recursion is not unbounded; a deep chain can exhaust its call stack.

items.explanation: Source permits a depth of 200000 nodes.
